meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条打分(0–3,每条须附证据),判断结论是 NEW、REFINE 还是 REDESIGN,并输出一份可直接运行的 /make-plan 交接提示词。产出落在 DESIGN-IS-<日期>/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你提到「audit this design」「design review」「check this UI against Rams」等关键词,或要求一次能导向计划的评审时接管。纯代码审查、纯文案修改不归它管。

say.text: 按 Rams 十条原则审这个页面,逐条打分
say.note: 生成证据、评分表与结论文件

say.text: 对这个组件做设计评审,给出 NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN 结论
审完后给我一份可直接用的 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: After install, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scoring each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and writes a ready-to-run /make-plan handoff prompt plus artifacts in DESIGN-IS-<date>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams" and similar, or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Routine UI code reviews and pure copy edits are excluded.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles and score each one
say_en.note: Writes evidence, scorecard and verdict files

say_en.text: Design review this component and give a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict
After the audit, hand me a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt
